description.value:
Features

Mastery Property (Topple)

If you hit a creature, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

Power Charge

Bonus Action.

As a Bonus Action, you begin winding up the hammer. The weapon remains charged for 1 minute, until you hit with an attack using it, until you are knocked Prone, or until you are Incapacitated. While charged, your walking speed increases by 5 feet, and your next successful attack with this weapon deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] bludgeoning damage.

Mighty Weapon

Special.

Once per turn when you hit a creature in the head (or just hit it) with a charged attack, you can unleash the built-up kinetic energy to rattle their brain. The target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, the creature is Stunned until the end of your next turn. A Huge or larger creature has Advantage on the saving throw. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest (tracked as this weapon's Limited Uses — open the item and lower Spent to restore a use after a rollback).
